mapper.insert: insert into t_friend_request (from_user, to_user, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{fromUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: select id, from_user, to_user, status, created_at, updated_at from t_friend_request where status = 0 and (from_user = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or to_user = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) order by updated_at desc
